key_patterns: No fence contamination — file is clean TypeScript.
All three spec-required validations are present: router.py parsing, dedup ledger idempotency, and dry-run output check.
Gate report is written even on error, which is correct behaviour for a checkpoint validator.
mkdir with recursive:true before writing the gate report prevents path-not-found failures.
DedupLedger test correctly verifies the duplicate throws a recognisable error message rather than just any error.
